WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Here's <Lore>Pooh's Honey Garden Pie</Lore>. Let us know what you think, Remy.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Tady je <Lore>Púův medový koláč ze zahrádky</Lore>. Dej nám vědět, co na něj říkáš, Remy.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Oh, this smells... interesting. Let me try a bit...
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Ó, to voní... zajímavě. Nech mě trochu ochutnat...

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: This is, um, sweet. Yes, very sweet. But there's a vegetal component, too.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Tohle je, um, sladké. Ano, velmi sladké. Ale je v tom cítit i ta zelenina.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: That's right. I hope that means it's delicious.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Správně. Doufám, že to znamená, že je lahodný.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Like my hero Gusteau, I believe that anyone can cook. But your dish might be a little too, um... odd for others. It did make me hungry for some honey-glazed carrots, though!
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Stejně jako můj hrdina Gusteau věřím, že vařit může každý. Ale tvé jídlo je možná trochu příliš, ehm... podivné pro ostatní. Rozhodně mi ale udělalo chuť na mrkve v medové glazuře!

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Well, I do like honey very much. So, I was hoping I could have a job that concerns it.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Inu, já mám med strašně rád. Takže jsem doufal, že bych mohl mít práci, která s ním souvisí.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: What if you got a job as...
...a factory worker putting honey in jars?
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: ...dělník v továrně, co dává med do sklenic?

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: ...a miner who finds gold and gems that are shiny like honey?
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: ...horník, co hledá zlato a drahokamy zářící jako med?

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: I don't think so. You see, I've found that bees get rather sting-y when I visit them.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: To si nemyslím. Zjistil jsem, že včely jsou poněkud pichlavé, když je navštívím.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: I do put honey in jars. But then I take it out to eat it.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Já dávám med do sklenic. Ale pak ho zase vyndavám, abych ho snědl.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Hey, that's not a bad idea. Aladdin knows a LOT about gems. He could give you some pointers.
WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.cz: Tohle není špatný nadpad. Aladin ví o drahokamech HODNĚ. Mohl by ti dát pár tipů.

WinnieDLC_Remy/Remy_VLG_Winn_030_VLG_Win.en: Oh yes. Let's go see Aladdin, {PlayerName}.
